• **Daniel Bernoulli (1700–1782):-**

 
 
• He was a Swiss mathematician and physicist.
 
• He is best known for his applications of mathematics to mechanics, especially fluid mechanics, and for his pioneering work in probability and statistics.
 
• **His name is prominently remembered through the principle of Bernoulli's equation, which describes the behavior of fluid flow.**

• **Evangelista Torricelli (1608-1647):-**

 
 
• He was an Italian physicist and mathematician, best known for his invention of the barometer, an instrument used to measure atmospheric pressure.
 
• This invention played a significant role in the development of the field of fluid dynamics.
